name: Astute
meaning: a student, a study; the word means sharp and observant
label: Crowded word
found: The owner's idea. First look: about nine App Store apps carry the word, two in Education (“Astute BFSL”, “Astutely”); an app named exactly “Astute” is on Google Play; astute.com is a B2B company, astute.app is for sale, astute.co.th is in use.

name: AstuteU
label: No similar product found
found: First look only: no app found; astuteu.com and astuteu.app did not resolve. Still built on a common word.

name: Termtrail
label: No similar product found
found: First look only: no app found; termtrail.com and termtrail.app did not resolve.

name: Termleaf
label: In use elsewhere
found: A live writing tool at termleaf.com (“Write. Nothing else.”). Same “leaf” association as Upleaf.

name: Upleaf
meaning: a page lifting up, like the logo
label: Dropped: reads as cannabis
found: No study or education product found. A posture-walking app, “Upleaf: Posture Walks” (Health & Fitness), is on the App Store, and a web agency uses upleaf.com. A wider check also reported an AI studio using the name at upleaf.io (that site would not load when checked directly). upleaf.app does not resolve. Chosen and dropped on the same day: “leaf” reads as cannabis, and the closest US mark, UPLEAF’D, is a cannabis-information site.

name: Termwise
label: Used by a school app
found: An app named Termwise is on Google Play: school-management software for Nigerian schools (termwise.org, very few downloads). Not on the App Store in the US or Thailand. termwise.com is for sale; termwise.app is an unrelated browser extension.

name: Semstra
label: Dropped: looks like a knock-off
found: Nothing found under this exact spelling (App Store US and Thailand, Google Play, semstra.com / .app / .co do not resolve). But Semestra, one letter longer and said the same way, is two Education apps on the App Store in Thailand and one on Google Play, all semester planners.

name: Gradetick
label: No similar product found
found: Nothing found anywhere; gradetick.com and .app unregistered. Leans towards grades rather than the whole app.

name: Owntick

name: Termtick
label: No similar product found
found: Only a hobby GitHub project of the same name. Sits near the TickTick brand.

name: Semestra
